Roll to remove Stunned

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your foe cleaves through your leg, severing it below the knee. You consider getting a peg leg.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (3) and @Condition[Stunned] (3). Also, lose your leg – @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.k00PimCWkff11IA0]{Amputation (Hard)}.
